text:
maria_cs: FYI we need a customer follow-up for the ~31-minute degradation. Can someone draft the recovery timeline + preventative actions? Please include SLA impact and whether credits are needed.
incbot: INCIDENT-2026-04-23T14:12Z - Severity: SEV2 - Affected: Hosted API (text-gen) - Status: Resolved - Root cause: routing overload on shard-7 - Pager runbook invoked.
ryan_oncall: I handled the pager — failover to standby region started at 14:19 UTC, traffic normalized by 14:43 UTC. Applied temporary throttles on long requests to stabilize KV/compile pressure.
alex_engineering: Root cause summary for ops: burst of long-context batched requests caused a compile backlog; kernel compile queue grew until a worker OOMed on shard-7. Mitigation was region failover + rollback of the runtime compile change.
maria_cs: Can you put that into a short customer-friendly timeline? Avoid internal jargon.
alex_engineering: Sure — draft timeline below:
```
14:12 UTC - Error rates and latencies increased for text-generation due to a compile backlog on one serving shard
14:19 UTC - On-call initiated failover to standby region to restore capacity
14:30 UTC - Temporary throttles applied to long requests to prevent further backlog growth
14:43 UTC - Traffic balanced and error rates returned to baseline
```
Planned fixes: increase compile-worker capacity, add queue backpressure, and an alert for compile queue depth.
maria_cs: Nice. @tina_csm can you review tone and add customer asks / next steps?
tina_csm: LGTM. Recommend we: apologize up front, state impact window, confirm we will review SLA credits per contract, and give an ETA for the full RCA doc.
jw_legal: Quick legal note — avoid committing to a specific dollar amount here. Use language like "we will review SLA credits per your contract" or "we will follow our SLA process."
ryan_oncall: Immediate preventative actions I'm taking now:
- Increase compile-worker count to 3x on affected cluster (in progress)
- Deploy backpressure patch to limit long request batching (ETA ~1h15m)
- Add alert: compile queue depth > 50 triggers pager
alex_engineering: Long-term mitigations: autoscale compile-workers based on queue depth, revert risky runtime compile behavior behind a feature flag, and add better telemetry for kernel compile latency.
maria_cs: Draft customer message (please edit for tone):
```
Hi <Customer>,

Apologies for the service degradation on 2026-04-23. We experienced a compile backlog in one serving shard that briefly increased error rates for text-generation. We failed over traffic to a standby region and applied throttles; normal service resumed within approximately 31 minutes.

What we're doing next:
- Reviewing SLA impact and will follow up on any credits per contract
- Implementing immediate fixes (increasing worker capacity and deploying backpressure)
- Publishing a full RCA with timeline and long-term mitigations by 2026-04-25

If you'd like a call to review impact, we can schedule one this week.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference
```
maria_cs: Final step — confirm who will send and when.
tina_csm: I will send to the customer at 16:00 UTC after a quick legal wording check.
jw_legal: I'll review now; ping me on any edits.
alex_engineering: I'll open prod action items, link the runbook, and attach the compile-queue traces.
ryan_oncall: I'll add the new alert and kick off the immediate deploy.
maria_cs: Thanks team — marking this thread for follow-up and adding to the cs incident tracker. :thumbsup:
